text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both miss out on victory at the Osaka Hai. 
However, Kitasan Black burns with 
determination to train harder and elevate 
herself even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown felt no rush either. After 
all, the glory she was aiming for was 
already within her sights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Fired up for a rematch against Duramente 
and Kitasan Black, preparations get 
underway—
